3.doc: ErrorText is shown instead of SupportingText, even if they are (today) independent
3.name: ErrorText

4.doc: Value contains the text, which shall be shown.
4.name: Value

6.doc: InputValue is a binding to a state, into which the frontend will the user entered text. This is the pointer a State.
6.name: InputValue

7.doc: Style to apply. Use TextFieldReduced in forms where many textfields cause too much visual noise and you need to reduce it. By default, the TextFieldOutlined is applied.
7.name: Style

8.doc: Leading shows the given component usually at the left (or right if RTL). This can be used for additional symbols like a magnifying glass for searching.
8.name: Leading

9.doc: Trailing show the given component usually at the right (or left if RTL mode). If set, the clear (or x button) must not be shown, to reduce distraction. This can be used for an Info button or a text showing a value unit.
9.name: Trailing

10.doc: Debounce configures the debouncing of the user input. By default, debouncing is enabled with the default time.
10.name: Debounce

11.doc: Lines enforces a single line if <= 0, otherwise it shows the amount of text lines within a text area.
11.name: Lines

16.doc: If Revealed the password is shown
16.name: Revealed

17.doc: Id represents an optional identifier to locate this component within the view tree. It must be either empty or unique within the entire tree instance.
17.name: Id

20.doc: ShowZero defines whether '0' should be displayed for empty/zero values of number fields.
20.name: ShowZero

21.doc: Step allows to set numeric steps, that will be used to increase/decrease the value stepwise.
21.name: Step

22.doc: Max defines the max value of a number field.
22.name: Max

23.doc: Min defines the min value of a number field.
23.name: Min

26.doc: ClearButton defines whether a clear button should be displayed for the text field. This only shows, if no trailing component is set, and the text field is not empty.
26.name: ClearButton

30.doc: SizeByContent sets the CSS property field-sizing to content on the input or textarea element, so that the field grows or shrinks with its content.
30.name: SizeByContent
